target.statement: Average test set MSE for sparse ridge regression with nested stability-regularized cross-validation on the Housing dataset (n=506, p=13), reported as 23.70 in Table 1.

compute.basis: No code released; must reimplement cyclic coordinate descent for l0-l2 sparse regression, nested stability-regularized CV with 10 lambda values, 20 gamma values, and 10 repeats of 90/10 splits; each model fit solves a mixed-integer problem via greedy rounding, and the paper reports ~592 seconds per dataset for nesting on a MacBook, so a full reimplementation and run on one dataset could take hours.

blockers: No code or configuration files released
Requires reimplementation of the sparse regression solver and nested CV procedure from scratch
Hyperparameter grids and exact coordinate descent details are only partially specified
title: Stability Regularized Cross-Validation
